pages.title: Shelter of the Creator
pages.text: Obtain a Totem of Undying to unlock the recipe. Sign a contract after crafting.$(br2)See $(l:herobrine_companion:key_items/hero_shelter)Shelter of the Creator$(/l) for materials, contract steps and usage.

pages.title: Recall Stone
pages.text: Unlocked by obtaining a Glitch Fragment. Requires a Memory Shard, Corrupted Code and other materials. Returns you to the recorded death location.

pages.title: Source Flow
pages.text: Unlocked by obtaining a Source Code Fragment. Uses Source Code Fragments, a Ghast Tear and Eyes of Ender.

pages.title: Awakened Vessel
pages.text: Crafted from Glitch Fragments, Memory Shards, a Source Code Fragment, an Eye of Ender and Crying Obsidian. See Awakened Mobs.
